ModMetaData.name: Tunnel Raids
ModMetaData.author: Sk
ModMetaData.description: Hostile raiders can now tunnel up from beneath your colony. A new raid arrival mode, built the way insect infestations are: a few tunnels rumble open near your colonists, then the raiders burst out and attack. With Biotech, mechanoid raids can tunnel up too, always led by at least one tunneler mech.
